title: 浪里的课
logline: 南海渔排上，初三女孩海花因台风停航无法正常上网课，班主任冒雨乘渔船送试卷，师生在晃动的渔排上完成特殊考试，诠释“浪再大，课不能停”的坚守。

shots.narrationZh: 台风刚过境，南海的浪还翻着白沫
shots.narrationEn: Typhoon just passed, the South China Sea waves still foam white.
shots.visual: Realistic South China Sea fish raft: wooden plank house on floating barrels, fishing nets and buoys swaying, raindrops hitting the sea surface making white spots, distant silhouettes of boats in the typhoon shelter.
shots.ttsDirection: 低沉有质感，语速稍缓，『浪』『白沫』重读，尾音带海风刮过的粗粝感，营造开场厚重氛围

shots.visual: 14-year-old Ha Hua sits at an old wooden table in the raft house, black ponytail tied with old red hair rope, school uniform covered with rainproof plastic, exam papers on her knees, looking anxiously at the swaying raft outside the window.

lines.zh: 阿爸，渡轮又停了，今天能上网课不？
lines.en: Dad, the ferry is stopped again, can I have online class today?

shots.ttsDirection: 语气平稳坚定，语速适中，『课』字轻咬，气息稳，带少女特有的执拗感，突出上网课的专注

shots.visual: Teacher Lin with short hair tucked behind ears stands at the door of the swaying raft house, wearing dark blue raincoat dripping with water, holding a paper bag wrapped in three layers of plastic bags full of exam papers, raindrops hitting the raft planks.

lines.zh: 海花开门，老师把试卷给你送来了！
lines.en: Ha Hua, open the door, I brought the exam papers for you!

shots.ttsDirection: 语气温暖关切，语速稍快，『试卷』重读，尾音带点被雨淋的湿气感，体现冒雨赶来的不易

shots.visual: Ha Hua's father collects fishing nets beside the raft, while Ha Hua and Teacher Lin sit face to face in the wooden house, exam papers spread on the small table between them, the whole raft sways slightly with the waves.

lines.zh: 丫头安心考，阿爸给你守着网箱
lines.en: Girl, take the exam with peace of mind, I'll guard the fish cages for you.

shots.ttsDirection: 语气沉稳平缓，语速放慢，尾音轻收，像父亲沉默注视时的呼吸感，不动声色却满含关切

shots.narrationEn: No matter how big the waves are, classes must go on.
shots.visual: In the swaying raft house, Ha Hua and Teacher Lin lower their heads to write the exam, a tablet showing the online class interface placed on the table, the rain stops outside, golden sunlight shines on the rippling sea surface.
shots.ttsDirection: 语气坚定昂扬，语速稍缓，『浪』『停』重读，尾音有力带出海风的韧劲，收束全片情绪
